blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent advances in generative artificial intelligence have accelerated video generation technologies. However, AI-generated videos (AIGVs) remain susceptible to various distortions, highlighting the need for dedicated video quality assessment methods. Content semantics play an important role in AIGV quality assessment, with source prompts typically used as textual references. However, these prompts may not accurately reflect the generated video content, resulting in a discrepancy between the intended textual description and the generated result. To address this limitation, this paper proposes VGCap, an AIGV quality assessment framework guided by visually grounded captions that align better with generated content. Specifically, we introduce two forms of captions: a global caption obtained by minimally revising the source prompt based on multi-frame visual evidence, and prompt-independent segment captions that describe localized temporal content. Together, these captions provide complementary textual evidence for assessing spatial quality, temporal quality, and text-video alignment. Experimental results on the LGVQ and FETV datasets show that VGCap outperforms representative baselines across all three dimensions. Further ablation studies on caption sources and temporal components confirm the effectiveness of visually grounded captions for each quality dimension, while highlighting the benefits of segment-level features for temporal quality prediction. The source of VGCap will be available at https://github.com/lolo123-123/VGCap.
blocks.zh: 最近基因人工智能的进步加速了视频生成技术. 然而,AI生成的视频(AIGVs)仍然容易受到各种扭曲,突出表明需要专门的视频质量评估方法. 内容语义在AIGV质量评估中起重要作用,源提示通常作为文字参考. 然而,这些提示可能无法准确反映所生成的视频内容,从而导致预期的文字描述和所生成的结果之间存在差异. 为解决这一限制,本文件建议采用以视觉为基础的、与生成内容更加一致的文字指导的AIGV质量评估框架VGCap。 具体来说,我们引入了两种形式的标题:一种是通过基于多框架视觉证据的最小修订源提示获得的全球标题,另一种是描述局部时间内容的即时独立片段标题。 这些标题加在一起,为评估空间质量、时间质量和文本视频相接提供了补充性文本证据。 LGVQ和FETV数据集的实验结果显示,VGCap超越了所有三个维度的代表性基线. 有关标题来源和时间组成部分的进一步研究证实了每个质量维度的视基标题的有效性,同时强调了分层特征对时间质量预测的益处。 VGCap的来源将在https://github.com/lolo123-123/VGCap上查阅.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Overall framework of VGCap. The Text Feature Extractor extracts features from the source prompt, global caption, and segment captions. The Spatial Feature Extractor derives frame-level spatial features. The Temporal Feature Extractor produces whole-video and segment-level motion features. The Adaptive Global Blend Gate fuses the branch-specific video and textual features, which are mapped to their corresponding scores by three quality predictors.

blocks.en: Recent advances in artificial intelligence-generated content have accelerated text-to-video synthesis [ 1 , 2 ] . However, AI-generated videos (AIGVs) often exhibit generation-specific defects, such as malformed objects, content inconsistency, unnatural motion, and semantic deviations from the source prompt [ 3 , 4 ] . These quality defects need to be captured by assessment models, when the AIGVs are evaluated.
blocks.zh: 人工智能生成内容的近期进步加快了文本到视频合成[1,2]. 然而,AI所生成的视频(AIGVs)往往表现出出出出出出世代特有的缺陷,如对象畸形,内容不一致,不自然运动,以及语义偏离源的快取[3,4]. 在评估AIGV时,这些质量缺陷需要被评估模型所记录.

blocks.en: Video quality assessment (VQA) plays an important role in evaluating perceptual video quality and supporting the optimization of video processing systems [ 5 ] . Previous VQA methods have primarily focused on perceptual distortions in natural or user-generated videos. An early method, VSFA, introduced content-aware features and temporal-memory modeling [ 6 ] . More recent methods, including RAPIQUE and FAST-VQA, integrated statistical and deep features or employed efficient fragment sampling, while DOVER separately modeled technical and aesthetic quality [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] . Although effective for general video distortions, these methods do not explicitly account for generation-specific defects or semantic correspondence with source prompts, limiting their applicability to AIGV quality assessment.
blocks.zh: 视频质量评估(VQA)在评价视觉视频质量和支持优化视频处理系统[5]方面发挥了重要作用. 以往的VQA方法主要侧重于自然或用户生成的视频中的认知扭曲. 早期方法"VSFA"引入了内容感知特征和时间记忆模型[6]. 最新方法,包括RAPIQUE和FAST-VQA、综合统计和深度特征或采用高效的碎片取样,而DOVER则分别对技术和美学质量进行模型化[7、8、9]。 虽然这些方法对一般的视频扭曲有效,但并未明确说明生成特定缺陷或与源提示的语义对应,使其适用于AIGV质量评估.

blocks.en: To address these challenges, AIGV quality assessment methods typically consider three complementary dimensions: spatial quality, temporal quality, and text-video alignment [ 4 , 10 ] . Existing methods generally adopt multimodal feature fusion and large vision-language models. Feature-fusion methods include Unify Generated Video Quality Assessment (UGVQ) model, which combines visual, motion, and prompt features [ 4 ] , and CRAVE, which jointly models text-video alignment and motion consistency [ 11 ] . Large multimodal model-based methods include AIGV-Assessor, which incorporates spatiotemporal and prompt information into large vision-language models (VLMs) [ 10 ] , and VQ-Insight, which adapts VLMs through progressive video-quality learning [ 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了应对这些挑战,AIGV质量评估方法通常考虑三个相辅相成的方面:空间质量、时间质量和文本视频对接[4、10]。 现有方法一般采用多模式特征聚变和大型视觉语言模型. 地物聚变方法包括Unify Entertained Video 质评(UGVQ)模型,该模型结合了视觉,运动和即时特性[4];而CRAVE则联合了文本-视频对接和运动一致性[11]. 基于多模式的大型方法包括AIGV-Assessor,该方法将瞬间和即时信息融入了大型视觉语言模型(VLM)[10];而VQ-Insight则通过进步的视频质量学习来适应VLM[12].

blocks.en: However, these approaches primarily rely on source prompts as textual references for evaluating semantic correspondence. A source prompt describes the intended video content but may not accurately reflect what is actually generated. Consequently, discrepancies between the source prompt and the generated video may limit the effectiveness of prompt-based features in representing the realized content. This motivates the use of visually grounded captions that directly describe the generated content while preserving the source prompt as a reference for the intended semantics.
blocks.zh: 然而,这些方法主要依靠源提示作为评价语义通信的文字参考. 消息源即时描述预定的视频内容,但可能无法准确反映实际生成的内容. 因此,源即时和生成的视频之间的差异可能限制即时功能在代表已实现内容方面的有效性。 这促使人们使用直接描述生成内容的可视化字幕,同时保留源提示作为预定语义的参考.

blocks.en: To address these limitations, we propose VGCap, a multidimensional AIGV quality assessment framework that complements the intended semantics of source prompt with visually grounded evidence of the realized video content. VGCap constructs two forms of captions: a global caption obtained by minimally revising the source prompt using multi-frame visual evidence, and prompt-independent segment captions describing localized temporal content. Caption construction is performed offline, decoupling the captioning models from predictor training and inference. Pretrained SigLIP2 [ 13 ] , SlowFast [ 14 ] , and BLIP [ 15 ] encoders extract spatial, motion, and textual features, respectively. Three dedicated branches then fuse the corresponding features to predict spatial quality, temporal quality, and text-video alignment. Experiments show that VGCap outperforms representative baselines across all three quality dimensions. Ablation studies confirm that the global caption improves prediction in all three dimensions and that segment-level motion and caption features further improve temporal quality prediction.
blocks.zh: 为了克服这些局限性,我们提议建立VGCap,这是一个多层面的AIGV质量评估框架,用视像证据补充源的预期语义即刻实现的视频内容。 VGCap构建了两种形式的标题:一种是通过使用多帧视觉证据对源代码进行最小修改而获得的全球标题,另一种是描述本地化时间内容的即时独立片段标题. 说明构建是离线进行的,将说明模型与预测器培训和推论脱钩。 Pretrained SigLIP2 [13],"慢快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快快 然后,三个专门分支将相应的特征相接,以预测空间质量、时间质量和文本视频相接。 实验显示,VGCap在所有三个质量维度上都超过了有代表性的基线. 阅读研究证实,全球字幕改进了所有三个层面的预测,分层运动和字幕的特点进一步提高了时间质量预测。

blocks.en: II Methodology
blocks.zh: 二. 方法

blocks.en: To address the discrepancy between source-prompt and actual video content, VGCap constructs visually grounded captions and integrates them with video features. As shown in Fig. 1 , we first describe the offline construction of global and segment captions (Sec. II-A ) and then introduce Adaptive Global Blend Gate (AGBG) for fusing video and textual features (Sec. II-B ), followed by the spatial, temporal, and text-video alignment branches (Sec. II-C – II-E ).
blocks.zh: 为了解决出自即时视频内容与实际视频内容之间的差异,VGCap构建了可视化的字幕并结合了视频功能. 如图1所示,我们首先描述了全球和分段标题的离线构建(Sec. II-A),然后引入了可适应的Global Blend Gate(AGBG),用于对视频和文本特性进行引信(Sec. II-B),然后是空间、时间和文本视频对接分支(Sec. II-C-II-E).

blocks.en: II-A Offline Caption Construction
blocks.zh: II-A 离线说明建筑

blocks.en: II-A 1 Global Caption
blocks.zh: II-A 1 全球说明

blocks.en: The global caption refines the source prompt to better describe the realized video content. For videos with at most 32 frames, all frames are retained; otherwise, 32 frames are uniformly sampled. A prompt-verification model decomposes the source prompt into six components: quantity, subject attributes, subject, action or state, object, and scene. Using only the sampled frames, a visual-description model independently generates descriptions for the same components. The prompt-verification model then verifies each prompt component as supported , contradicted , or uncertain based on frame content. Supported and uncertain components are retained, while contradicted components are replaced with the corresponding verified visual descriptions. The components are recomposed into a global caption while preserving the source-prompt structure.
blocks.zh: 全球字幕完善了源码提示来更好地描述已实现的视频内容. 对于最多32帧的视频,所有帧被保留;否则,32帧被统一取样. 一个即时核查模型将源分解出源分解为六个组成部分:数量,主题属性,主题,动作或状态,物体,和场景. 仅使用被取样的帧,可视化描述模型独立生成相同组件的描述. 即时核查模式随后将每个即时组件校验为支持、矛盾或基于帧内容的不确定。 支持和不确定的组件被保留,而相矛盾的组件被相应的已核实的视觉描述所取代. 这些组件被重新组合成一个全局标题,同时保留源-即时结构.

blocks.en: II-A 2 Segment Captions
blocks.zh: 二-A 2个部分的说明

blocks.en: Segment captions describe localized temporal content. Videos with fewer than 16, 16–23, 24–31, and at least 32 frames are evenly divided into one, two, three, and four non-overlapping segments, respectively. Up to eight frames are uniformly sampled from each segment. For each segment, the visual-description model generates an initial caption describing the visible subjects, actions or states, objects, and scene. The prompt-verification model verifies the caption against the corresponding frames. If an inconsistency is detected, the visual-description model revises the caption using the verification feedback, followed by a second verification. This frame-only process keeps the segment captions independent of the source prompt and other captions. A binary mask excludes padded segments during training.
blocks.zh: 片段标题描述本地化的时间内容 。 少于16道,16–23道,24–31道和至少32道相框的视频分别被平分为1道,2道,3道和4道不相重叠的片段. 从每个段对多达8个框架进行统一取样。 对于每个片段,可视化描述模型生成一个初始标题来描述可见的主题,动作或状态,对象,和场景. 快速核查模型对照相应的框架验证标题。 如果检测出不一致,可视化描述模型会使用验证反馈修改标题,然后进行第二次验证. 这个只设定帧的进程使片段标题独立于源头即时字幕和其他标题. 二进制口罩不包括训练时加分.

blocks.en: II-A 3 Caption Construction Details
blocks.zh: II-A 3 说明建筑细节

blocks.en: The prompt-verification model is implemented using Qwen3-VL-8B [ 16 ] , while the visual-description model uses VideoLLaMA3-7B [ 17 ] . Both models are used only during offline caption construction.
blocks.zh: 即时核查模型使用Quen3-VL-8B [16],而视觉描述模型使用VideoLLAMA3-7B [17]. 两种模型仅在线下字幕构建时使用.

blocks.en: II-B Adaptive Global Blend Gate
blocks.zh: II-B 适应性全球组合门

Each fusion stage learns an independent gate shared across all samples. The spatial and temporal branches apply this formulation to video-text feature pairs, while the alignment branch extends it to three features using softmax-normalized weights.

blocks.en: II-C Spatial Quality Assessment
blocks.zh: II-C 空间质量评估

blocks.en: II-D Temporal Quality Assessment
blocks.zh: 二. 临时质量评估

blocks.en: Temporal quality depends on both overall motion and localized changes across video segments. We therefore combine whole-video and segment-level motion features with caption features at the corresponding temporal scales. We first use a pretrained SlowFast-R50 [ 14 ] encoder to extract a whole-video motion feature from the video and K K segment-level motion features from the temporal segments used for segment-caption construction in Sec. II-A2 . After linear projection, these features are denoted by 𝐯 t \mathbf{v}_{t} and { 𝐦 k } k = 1 K \{\mathbf{m}_{k}\}_{k=1}^{K} , where K K is the number of valid segments and 𝐦 k \mathbf{m}_{k} denotes the motion feature of the k k -th segment. To provide semantic context at the same temporal scales, we use BLIP to extract features from the global caption and segment captions. After linear projection, these features are denoted by 𝐜 \mathbf{c} and { 𝐬 k } k = 1 K \{\mathbf{s}_{k}\}_{k=1}^{K} , respectively, where 𝐬 k \mathbf{s}_{k} denotes the caption feature of the k k -th segment.
blocks.zh: 时间质量既取决于整体运动,也取决于各视频段的局部变化。 因此,我们将全视频和分层运动特征与相应时间尺度的字幕特征结合起来。 我们首先使用预先训练的SlowFast-R50 [14]编码器,从视频中提取出一个全视频运动特征,从Sec. II-A2中用于分段封装构造的时段中提取出K分段级运动特征. 线性投影后,这些特征由v t\ mathbf{v}_{t}和{ m k}} k = 1 K → mathbf{ m}_{k}\}_{k= 1}^{K}表示,其中K为有效片段数,而m k\ mathb{ m}_{k}表示 k-th片段的运动特征. 为了提供相同时间尺度的语义上下文,我们使用BLIP从全局标题和片段标题中提取出特征. 线性投影后,这些特性由c\ mathbf{c}和{ s k} 分别表示为 1 K\ mathbf{ s}_{k}\}_{k=k= 1}^{K},其中 s k\ mathbf{ s}_{k} 表示为 k k-th 段的字幕特性.

blocks.en:
Following Eq. ( 1 ), we apply AGBG at the whole-video and segment levels as 𝐮 t = ( 1 − α t ) ​ 𝐯 t + α t ​ 𝐜 \mathbf{u}_{t}=(1-\alpha_{t})\mathbf{v}_{t}+\alpha_{t}\mathbf{c} and 𝐮 k = ( 1 − β t ) ​ 𝐦 k + β t ​ 𝐬 k \mathbf{u}_{k}=(1-\beta_{t})\mathbf{m}_{k}+\beta_{t}\mathbf{s}_{k} , respectively. Here, α t , β t ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \alpha_{t},\beta_{t}\in[0,1] control the contributions of the global and segment caption features, while 𝐮 t \mathbf{u}_{t} and 𝐮 k \mathbf{u}_{k} denote the resulting whole-video and k k -th segment fused features. blocks.en: III Experiments
blocks.zh: 三. 实验

blocks.en: III-A Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 三-A 实验设置

blocks.en: III-A 1 Evaluation Datasets
blocks.zh: 评价数据集

blocks.en: VGCap is evaluated on the Large-scale Generated Video Quality assessment (LGVQ) dataset [ 4 ] and the Fine-grained Evaluation of Text-to-Video generation (FETV) benchmark [ 20 ] . LGVQ contains 2,808 videos generated by six models from 468 source prompts and provides MOS labels for spatial quality, temporal quality, and text-video alignment. FETV contains 2,476 videos generated by four models from 619 source prompts; its static-quality, temporal-quality, and overall-alignment scores supervise the corresponding VGCap branches. For both datasets, videos sharing the same source prompt are assigned to the same subset. We construct ten prompt-disjoint splits, each using a 7:1:2 training/validation/test ratio. Performance is evaluated using the Spearman rank-order correlation coefficient (SRCC) and Pearson linear correlation coefficient (PLCC) [ 4 ] . Results are averaged over the ten test sets.
blocks.zh: VGCap在"大规模生成视频质量评估"(LGVQ)数据集[4]和"精细的文本到视频生成评价"(FETV)基准[20]上评价. LGVQ包含由468个出自源提示的6个模型所生成的2,808个视频,并提供MOS标签,用于空间质量,时间质量,和文本-视频对接. FETV包含由从619个出自源提示的4个模型生成的2,476个视频;其静态质量,时间质量,以及整体对接分数监督相应的VGCap分支. 对于两个数据集,共享同源快取的视频被分配到同一个子集. 我们用7: 1: 2的训练/验证/测试比率,建造了10个快速-分解分解。 性能评价采用斯皮尔曼阶次相干系数(SRCC)和皮尔逊线性相干系数(PLCC)[4]. 10套测试结果平均。

blocks.en: III-A 2 Compared Methods
blocks.zh: 比较方法

blocks.en: For a controlled comparison, we focus on encoder-based baselines and exclude assessors built on substantially larger multimodal models. For spatial quality, the baselines include the image quality assessment (IQA) methods UNIQUE [ 21 ] , MUSIQ [ 22 ] , CLIP-IQA [ 23 ] , and LIQE [ 24 ] , together with UGVQ [ 4 ] . For temporal quality, we compare with the VQA methods RAPIQUE [ 7 ] , VSFA [ 6 ] , SimpleVQA [ 25 ] , FAST-VQA [ 8 ] , DOVER [ 9 ] , and UGVQ. Text-video alignment baselines include CLIPScore [ 26 ] , BLIP [ 15 ] , ImageReward [ 27 ] , PickScore [ 28 ] , HPSv2 [ 29 ] , and UGVQ.
blocks.zh: 为了进行有控制的比较,我们把重点放在基于编码器的基线上,排除了建立在大得多的多式联运模型上的评审员。 关于空间质量,基线包括图像质量评估方法UNIQUE [21],MUSIQ [22],CLIP-IQA [23],和LIQE [24],以及UGVQ [4]. 对于时间质量,我们比较VQA方法 RAPIQUE [7],VSFA [6],SimpleVQA [25],FAST-VQA [8],DOVER [9],和UGVQ. 文本-视频对接基线包括CLIPScore [26],BLIP [15],图像奖励 [27],PickScore [28],HPSv2 [29],和UGVQ.

blocks.en: III-A 3 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 三-A 3 执行细节

blocks.en: VGCap is trained for 5 epochs using AdamW with a batch size of 4, an initial learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , a weight decay of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , and a cosine learning-rate schedule. In the spatial and alignment branches, SigLIP2 uses the global-caption frame-sampling strategy (Sec. II-A1 ), while SigLIP2 and BLIP are frozen in epoch 1 and their final two blocks and layers are fine-tuned thereafter at 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} and 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} , respectively. The temporal branch uses fixed, pre-extracted SlowFast and BLIP features. We initialize α s = 0.33 \alpha_{s}=0.33 , ( α t , β t , λ t ) = ( 0.33 , 0.45 , 0.65 ) (\alpha_{t},\beta_{t},\lambda_{t})=(0.33,0.45,0.65) , and ( w V , w P , w C ) = ( 0.55 , 0.25 , 0.20 ) (w_{V},w_{P},w_{C})=(0.55,0.25,0.20) . The ranking-loss weight λ r \lambda_{r} and margin are set to 0.3 0.3 and 0.05 0.05 , respectively. For each trainable model, the checkpoint with the highest validation SRCC is used for testing. All experiments are conducted on a single NVIDIA GH200 GPU.

blocks.en: All baselines with public implementations are reproduced using their official code and the same data splits as VGCap. For frame-based IQA baselines, we follow the global-caption frame-sampling strategy in Sec. II-A1 and average frame-level predictions to obtain video-level quality scores. Video-based VQA methods follow their original sampling and inference procedures. Alignment measures obtain video-level scores by averaging frame-level image-text alignment or preference scores over the same sampled frames. The UGVQ results are taken from its original paper because its public repository provides the dataset but not the implementation.
blocks.zh: 所有有公共执行的基线都使用其官方代码复制,数据与VGCap相同。 对于基于帧的IQA基线,我们遵循Sec. II-A1中的全球封装帧采样策略和平均帧水平的预测,以获得视频级别的质量分数. 基于视频的VQA方法遵循其原始的采样和推断程序. 对齐措施通过平均帧水平图像文本对齐或偏好得分而获得视频级别的分数,而不是同一被抽样的分数. UGVQ的结果取自其原始的论文,因为其公共寄存器提供了数据集,而不是执行.

blocks.en: III-B Performance Comparison
blocks.zh: 三-B 业绩比较

blocks.en: Table I compares VGCap with representative image quality, video quality, and text-video alignment assessment methods on LGVQ and FETV. Among the methods, VGCap achieves the best performance across all three quality dimensions in both datasets, with the most pronounced improvement in text-video alignment. These results validate the effectiveness of VGCap’s overall design for multidimensional AIGV quality assessment.
blocks.zh: 表一比较了VGCap在LGVQ和FETV上具有代表性的图像质量,视频质量,以及文本视频校正评估方法. 在方法中,VGCap在两个数据集的所有三个质量维度中都取得了最佳的性能,在文本-视频对接方面得到了最显著的改进. 这些结果证实了VGCap对多层面AIGV质量评估的总体设计的有效性.

Adding segment-level motion and caption features progressively improves temporal performance. For text-video alignment, combining the spatial feature with both the source prompt and global caption achieves the best result. blocks.en: IV Conclusion
blocks.zh: 四. 结论

blocks.en: This paper presented VGCap, a multidimensional AIGV quality assessment framework guided by visually grounded captions. VGCap constructs a global caption from multi-frame visual evidence and prompt-independent segment captions for localized temporal content, to obtain better content awareness. Experiments on LGVQ and FETV show strong performance across all three quality dimensions, with the largest gains in text-video alignment. Ablations confirm that the global caption improves all three dimensions and that segment-level features further enhance temporal quality prediction. These results show that visually grounded captions help assess generated videos based on their actual content. A current limitation is that offline caption construction requires additional VLM inference, increasing computational cost. Future work will explore automated caption verification and more efficient integration of caption construction with quality assessment.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍了VGCap,这是一个多维的AIGV质量评估框架,以视觉字幕为指南。 VGCap从多框架视觉证据中构建一个全局字幕,以及针对本地化时间内容的即时独立片段字幕,以获得更好的内容意识. LGVQ和FETV的实验显示出在所有三个质量维度上的强效性能,在文本-视频对接方面收获最大. 缺损证实,全球标题改进了所有三个层面,分层特征进一步提高了时间质量预测。 这些结果显示,视网膜字幕有助于根据其实际内容评估生成的视频。 目前的一项限制是,离线字幕构建需要额外的VLM推论,从而增加了计算成本. 今后的工作将探索自动字幕核查,并更有效地将字幕建设与质量评估结合起来。
